Name: Dancer
Effect: Once per Round, if a Pokémon uses a Dance Move, this Pokémon may use its next Action to use the same Move immediately after, as a Reaction 6 Move with the same number of successes on Accuracy; Damage must still be rolled. Rampage Moves are only used once.
Description: When someone begins to dance, this Pokémon dances too. It expresses its feelings and communicates through little jigs.
